mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days in any economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns negative in >55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns positive in >55% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts and rise in consumer price inflation signal a weakening housing sector and rising inflation, indicating economic contraction and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns positive in >55% of instances when HOUST declines and CPIAUCSL rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In early economic expansions (UNRATE < 4.0%), strong industrial production growth (INDPRO > 105.0) signals robust corporate activity and rising profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns negative in >55% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0% and INDPRO > 105.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in employment (PAYEMS) indicates strong labor market conditions, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days in any economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns negative in >55% of instances when PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1150.0 thousand units signals a weakening housing market, reducing construction activity and consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns positive in >55% of instances when HOUST < 1150.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate and decline in industrial production signals monetary tightening coinciding with economic slowdown, indicating high recession risk and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns positive in >55% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises and INDPRO falls, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 105.0 signals a contraction in manufacturing and services, reducing corporate profits and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns positive in >55% of instances when INDPRO < 105.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.
